g.title: FIX — approved mirrored channel assembly and endpoint-stop lead-ins

g.text: FIX —141-LAYER ASSEMBLY WITH APPROVED MIRRORED CHANNELS
10 platform + 8 replacement channel + 1 roof + 122 upper inlet layers = 141 layers.
Channels start Z0.660; roof Z1.140; upper inlets Z1.200; final height Z8.460 mm. No added startup.
Layers 11–18: both channel/diagonal pairs print first,
then the eight extended horizontal lines.
CIRCLE CLEARANCE ENDPOINTS — SAME ON ALL EIGHT LAYERS
Solid outline = circular region outer boundary
Both paired endpoints have a 0.300 mm gap.
Gray dots: old ends. Blue: inward extensions.
Solid outline = circular region outer boundary
Both paired endpoints have a 0.300 mm gap.
Gray dots: old ends. Blue: inward extensions.
Solid outline = circular region outer boundary
Both paired endpoints have a 0.300 mm gap.
Gray dots: old ends. Blue: inward extensions.
Solid outline = circular region outer boundary
Both paired endpoints have a 0.300 mm gap.
Gray dots: old ends. Blue: inward extensions.
Gap definition: shortest XY distance from the line’s nozzle-centerline endpoint to the nominal Ø3.29 mm outer circle.
Width 0.30 mm · flow 1.4 · 25 mm/s on layers 11–18 · extrusion recalculated for each full extended line.
LAYER 19 ONLY — ONE UNINTERRUPTED BOTTOM-TO-TOP ROOF PATH PER SIDE
Each arm extrudes once, with no overlapping passes.
Their combined span is 7.566055 source units.
Right roof = exact reflection of left about X128.
Only the straight connector is trimmed by 0.001378 mm
to land exactly on both existing starting points.
Overlapping passes removed: each arm prints once.
15 deposition moves per side, including 2 true arcs.
Preview sampled directly from actual G-code arc centers.
Roof settings: width 0.30 mm · height 0.06 mm · flow 1.4
Legacy filenames retained. This base section ends at Z1.140; the continuation follows on layer 20.
LAYER 19 FINISHES — AFTER BOTH EXISTING CONTINUOUS ROOF PATHS
1 Left top → 2 Left bottom → 3 Right top → 4 Right bottom. Same Z1.140; no additional layer.
Start anchors: outer endpoints of the topmost /
Each copy is one straight move plus one arc.
Two mirror operations: X128 and Y127.9993365.
Stationary endpoint retract; custom reverse arc wipe removed.
All existing paths retained. Only four finish copies are appended after the two original roof paths on layer 19.
LAYER 19 FULL ROOF FILLS — PRINTED AFTER ALL PRECEDING ROOF AND FINISH PATHS
Every layer-19 component starts at its outer endpoint and first extrudes inward: left → right, right → left.
Orca overhang motion and the drawn overlap
Right file reversed to begin at its outer endpoint;
right emitted geometry is an exact mirror of left.
Existing height 0.06 mm / flow 1.4 used for E.
All earlier layer 19 paths retain their own settings.
LAYERS 20–141 — FOUR CIRCULAR INLETS REGISTERED TO LAYER-19 CENTERS
The entire uploaded print is appended. Original source geometry is translated per circle; no scaling is applied.
First new layer: Z1.200. 122 new layers × 0.060 mm = 7.320 mm. Final model height: 8.460 mm.
Schematic height stack: existing Z0–1.14 mm,
then four inlet walls rising to Z8.46 mm.
No homing, vibration/flow calibration, purge or heater wait.
Upper inlet source E/width/fans retained; 245°C / 70°C / K0.05.
Source first layer 3 mm/s; later layers 4 mm/s (updated from 5).
Each circle is rigidly translated to the corresponding roof center.
One startup at the beginning and one final shutdown after layer 141; the printer does not restart between stages.
Both start at the same outer endpoints as layers 1–10; inward endpoints remain fixed.
Same endpoints; all lead-ins after layer10 useK0.05/flow0.98 at original25mm/s; no extra slow-start.
Custom backward wipes removed. Stop, stationary retract, lift; native source-loop wipes retained.
